dropdown.$description: Stacking layer for dropdown and select popovers. Fixed ordering: dropdown < sticky < overlay < toast < tooltip.

sticky.$description: Stacking layer for sticky headers and pinned UI. Fixed ordering: dropdown < sticky < overlay < toast < tooltip.

overlay.$description: Stacking layer for modal dialogs and their backdrops. Fixed ordering: dropdown < sticky < overlay < toast < tooltip.

toast.$description: Stacking layer for toasts and transient notifications. Fixed ordering: dropdown < sticky < overlay < toast < tooltip.

tooltip.$description: Topmost stacking layer, for tooltips. Fixed ordering: dropdown < sticky < overlay < toast < tooltip.
